title: Ready for IELTS, Unit 7: first conditional; work

fixIt.text: If I get the job, I would move to Phnom Penh.
fixIt.explain: A real possibility: if + present, will.

fixIt.text: Unless you apply now, you miss the deadline.
Provided you work hard, you will be promote.
If you heat water to 100°C, it will boils.
I'll call you when I finished.
If she won't come, we'll start without her.
fixIt.explain: No will after if: If she doesn't come.

builder.text: If I get the job, I'll move.
alternatives: I'll move if I get the job.

builder.text: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
alternatives: You'll be late unless you hurry.

radio.title: Preparing for an interview
radio.text: Career advisers say that if you prepare well, you will feel much more confident in a job interview. Find out about the company before you go, and think of examples from your own experience. If you are asked about a weakness, give an honest answer and explain what you are doing to improve. Unless the interviewer has already explained everything, prepare one or two questions of your own.
